browser.name: Google Chrome
browser.method: Playwright on localhost; each 120x80 element is captured as a Chrome screenshot and pixel samples are read from that PNG.

assets.description: Opaque red left half and blue right half.
Red/blue top half with a transparent bottom half.
Semitransparent green/yellow top half and transparent bottom half; PNG bytes omitted.

interpretation.backgroundLayerOrder: CSS background-image layer 0 is painted on top of layer 1, then subsequent layers; background-color is beneath all image layers.
interpretation.cyclicLonghandLists: background-size, background-position, and background-repeat values repeat from the start when fewer values are present than background-image layers; effectivePerImageLayer records the applied list index for each layer.
interpretation.screenshotPixels: RGBA values are sampled from the actual PNG bytes returned by locator.screenshot(); screenshot base64 is not stored.
interpretation.coverage: Eight specified multilayer-background cases at 390px viewport, light scheme, and device scale factor 1; no claim about other widths or broader background grammar.
